caption: The drawing depicts a piece of needlework or embroidery centered on a light brown, textured square background. In the composition, there are two stylized birds, both shaded in red and pink, facing each other on either side of a symmetrical central flower stalk that is green with large, red blossoms at the top. To the left of the birds, a geometric birdhouse or similar structure, outlined with red, blue, and green, appears, with a pink-spiked flower above it. At the bottom center, there is a blue and orange bowl or urn shape supporting the green stalk above it. There are also two large flower shapes, one on the lower left in shades of pink and blue, and one on the lower right in muted blue, green, and pink. The entire stitched piece is framed by a simple, hand-drawn rectangular border on off-white paper, and the name “ESTHER M. ARTINDALE” is written in small capital letters at the bottom right of the outer border.
title: Sampler
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
